title: 花园门 Huayuan Men
subtitle: Hua Yuan Men, Flower Garden Gate · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: platform 0.3 m, eave 4.5 m, ridge 6 m above the ground

evidence.title: Plate IV: 花园门 Huayuan Men
evidence.excerpt_other: Aux pieds des colonnes sont deux cippes sur lesquels posent deux lions accroupis,
evidence.summary: Arch with two columns and entablature, two crouching lions on cippi. Panelled wall carried on a small bridge, river below with two more small bridges.

evidence.title: Engraving 4: 花园门 Huayuan Men
evidence.excerpt_other: The wall was of gray brick cut smooth and decorated with a large pattern in pink and a deep cream tint.
evidence.summary: North side of the maze gate, seen from inside; 蓄水楼 visible over the wall. Wall colours as quoted, source of the colours not stated.

evidence.title: 万花阵 and 花园门; 线法山 and 螺蛳牌楼, yaffin 系列02, 13
evidence.summary: Lead: the maze gate 花园门 is shaped like a Western clock case with two brass doors; the maze 89 x 59 m, walls about 1.2 m high and over 1,600 m long; the hill 线法山 has a gate each side, the east one called 螺蛳牌楼. Check against the engravings.

photos.title: 花园门北面 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 四 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)

photos.why: Printed title. Viewer looks south, so the hall over the wall on the right (west) is 蓄水楼: S02 pp.143-144 says it is seen over the wall. The foreground bridge has no id.
